name: SoundCloud Likes Player
author: papershoes22
description: A player for your SoundCloud likes, in the bar. Its shuffle covers your entire likes library: every like has an equal chance and nothing repeats until you've heard them all, instead of cycling the recent likes a web page happens to have loaded. The pill shows what's playing, with a progress line; the dropdown has cover art, a scrubber, transport and volume, a 10-band EQ, what's up next, and a full library window with search. Optional: keep local copies of your likes (off by default), and play on another machine with this one as the remote. Runs in the bundled `sclikes` user service (mpv + yt-dlp).

barWidget.description: Now playing from your SoundCloud likes, with true whole-library shuffle, a player dropdown and a full library window.
